title: A reconstructed teamster at Wolf Point
items: Otis Bardwell, an existing reconstructed 1835 resident, stands near the Wolf Point wagons. Select him to open his own resident card. His appearance and placement are reconstructed; photographic finishing remains in progress.
Bardwell’s exported waistcoat now has connected shoulder panels in place of the clipped front. Further period tailoring and photographic finishing remain in progress.
His card now identifies the invented identity and model-assigned firm connection explicitly. Source-named residents retain their evidence labels.
